status.notice: This is scaffolding, not the essay. Every chapter, scene, line, and illustration here is a structural stand-in used to build and check the website before the writing exists. Nothing below states a position held by TJ, Koj, or Vier, no friend shown here is a real person, and no source listed here has been checked passage by passage yet.

project.title: What Does It Take to Be Happy?
project.question: What does it take to be happy?
project.summary: Happiness takes different forms. Small joys count, while security, time, relationships, and freedom shape who can sustain them. This is a working synthesis, not a formula that predicts feelings or erases disagreements.
